Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: Squirrel sent out an invitation but he did not send to Raven. / As soon as the guests of Squirrel were in Raven went out to the point. He eased himself. "You will say, / dung, 'Hoʼxstalag·imîx·, the Warriors are coming,' you will say." Then / it said, "Hoʼxstalag·imîx·, the Warriors are coming!" Now he said so. / The guests of Squirrel went out at once. Then Raven went in and ate with his hands / the berries. Then an old woman shouted, "Come! The food for your guests, Squirrel, has all been taken by Raven." "Keep quiet, little old woman. You may lick it out." Then Squirrel came. "That is just one of your plans, / you bad one with your shining nose!"
